result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [list_adam_datasets()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: List the ADaM dataset templates. twitter-card: title: >- [list_adam_datasets()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} | Pointblank description: List the ADaM dataset templates. title: >- [list_adam_datasets()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: List the ADaM dataset templates. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} List the ADaM dataset templates. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_adam_templates.py#L998-L1030){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature list_adam_datasets() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} These are the names that [`get_adam_dataset()`](`pointblank.get_adam_dataset`), [`validate_adam()`](`pointblank.validate_adam`), [`validate_adam_structure()`](`pointblank.validate_adam_structure`) and [`adam_to_metadata()`](`pointblank.adam_to_metadata`) accept. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The template names, in alphabetical order. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Let's list the templates, together with each one's label: ::: {#67abf983 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb for name in pb.list_adam_datasets(): print(f"{name:7}{pb.get_adam_dataset(name).label}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ADAE Adverse Event Analysis Dataset ADSL Subject Level Analysis Dataset ADTTE Time-to-Event Analysis Dataset BDS Basic Data Structure ``` ::: ::: BDS is a structure rather than a single dataset, so its template is used for any BDS dataset in a study, such as ADVS or ADLB. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~get_adam_dataset`) : Get a dataset template. [](`~list_sdtm_domains`) : The equivalent for SDTM domains.
